title: Talking about quality experience
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a falar de experiências usando o Present Perfect (have/has + particípio). No setor de Qualidade e PCP da Delta Ducon, você vai poder dizer o que já fez em auditorias, inspeções e não conformidades sem precisar da data exata — algo que aparece o tempo todo em conversas com clientes e auditores da ISO 9001.
intro: In Quality and Production Planning, people often ask what you have done before. Have you ever run an ISO audit? Have you inspected a gas cleaning system?
Today we practise the present perfect for experience. It helps you talk about your work at Delta Ducon without saying exactly when it happened.
introAudio: Hello. I have worked in quality control for several years. I have inspected many systems and I have run internal audits. Today we will talk about your experience at Delta Ducon.
vocab: I have inspected the dust collector three times this year.
We have audited two suppliers this quarter.
The team has approved the new inspection report.
I have reported every non-conformity to the manager.
She has measured the emission levels at the plant.
We have traced the part back to its batch number.
practice: I have ______ the gas scrubber before delivery.
We have ______ three suppliers this year.
The manager has ______ the final quality report.
I have ______ two non-conformities this week.
She has ______ the dust levels at the Diadema plant.
We have ______ the defect back to one batch.
He has ______ the welding on every panel.
They have ______ the delivery on time.

audio.title: My experience in quality
audio.text: I have worked in quality control at Delta Ducon for many years. I have inspected dust collectors, scrubbers and gas cleaning systems. I have run several internal audits under ISO 9001. I have reported many non-conformities and I have helped the team fix them. I have never ignored a safety problem. My experience has made our deliveries more reliable.

readAloud: I have inspected many gas cleaning systems.
We have audited three suppliers this year.
The team has approved the quality report.
She has measured the emission levels twice.
I have never missed a non-conformity.
fill: He ___ traced the defect to one batch. (have/has)
I ___ never seen this failure before. (have/has)
qa: Have you ever run an internal audit?
Yes, I have run several internal audits.
What have you inspected this month?
I have inspected the dust collectors and the scrubbers.
Has the manager approved the report?
Yes, he has approved it.
Have you ever found a serious non-conformity?
Yes, I have found a few and I have reported them.
How long have you worked in quality control?
I have worked in quality control for several years.
sentences: I have inspected many gas cleaning systems.
We have audited two suppliers this quarter.
The manager has approved the final report.
I have reported every non-conformity this week.
She has measured the emission levels at the plant.
We have traced the defect back to one batch.
I have never ignored a safety problem.
The team has improved our delivery process.
grammarPoint: Present Perfect para experiência: have/has + particípio passado. Usamos para falar de algo que já aconteceu na sua vida, sem dizer quando. I have inspected the scrubber. — Eu já inspecionei o lavador. She has audited two suppliers. — Ela já auditou dois fornecedores.
deepDive: Use 'have' com I, you, we, they e 'has' com he, she, it. O particípio de verbos regulares termina em -ed (inspected, audited). Palavras como 'ever', 'never' e 'already' combinam bem com essa estrutura para falar de experiência.
examples: I have inspected the scrubber.
Eu já inspecionei o lavador de gases.
We have audited three suppliers.
Nós já auditamos três fornecedores.
She has approved the report.
Ela já aprovou o relatório.
He has reported the non-conformity.
Ele já reportou a não conformidade.
They have measured the dust levels.
Eles já mediram os níveis de poeira.
I have traced the defect to one batch.
Eu já rastreei o defeito até um lote.
We have improved the process.
Nós já melhoramos o processo.
I have never missed a deadline.
Eu nunca perdi um prazo.
Have you ever run an audit?
Você já conduziu uma auditoria?
The team has finished the inspection.
A equipe já terminou a inspeção.
mistakes: Com I usamos have, não has.
Depois de have vem o particípio (inspected).
Com never não usamos outra negativa.
Com you usamos have na pergunta.

celebrate.en: Well done. You can now talk about your professional experience with confidence — a skill every quality specialist needs.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Agora você sabe falar da sua experiência profissional com confiança — uma habilidade que todo especialista em qualidade precisa.

title: Experience now, facts in the past
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a diferença entre o Present Perfect (experiência, sem data) e o Past Simple (fato com data ou momento definido). Em Qualidade e PCP da Delta Ducon, isso é essencial para relatar corretamente quando uma auditoria aconteceu ontem versus quando você já fez auditorias em geral.
intro: Both tenses talk about the past, but they are used differently. 'I have audited three suppliers' shows experience. 'I audited a supplier yesterday' gives a fact with a time.
Today we compare the present perfect and the past simple, so you can report your quality work at Delta Ducon clearly and correctly.
introAudio: I have inspected many systems, and I inspected the last one yesterday. In this lesson we compare experience and finished time so your quality reports are always clear.
vocab: The team has already approved the report.
I inspected the scrubber last week.
We have recently updated the checklist.
We met the delivery deadline on Friday.
The schedule has changed since Monday.
practice: The manager has ______ signed the report.
We have ______ improved the inspection form.
The team met the delivery ______ on time.
The production ______ has changed since Monday.
She has ______ traced the defective batch.

audio.title: This week in quality
audio.text: This has been a busy week for the quality team. We have completed two internal audits and we have closed several non-conformities. Yesterday I inspected the new scrubber at the Diadema plant. Last week we measured the emission levels and sent the report to the client. The team has already updated the inspection checklist, and we finished the last review on Friday. Overall, we have improved our process a lot this month.

readAloud: I have inspected many systems this year.
I inspected the scrubber yesterday.
We have already closed the non-conformity.
We closed the audit last week.
The schedule has changed recently.
fill: I ___ inspected the plant yesterday. (inspected/have inspected)
We ___ already finished the audit. (finished/have finished)
She ___ the report last week. (approved/has approved)
They ___ never missed a deadline. (missed/have missed)
I ___ the dust levels on Monday. (measured/have measured)
We ___ recently updated the checklist. (updated/have updated)
He ___ the supplier last month. (audited/has audited)
The team ___ just closed the case. (closed/has closed)
qa: Have you finished the audit?
Yes, I have already finished it.
When did you inspect the scrubber?
I inspected it yesterday.
Have you ever worked with ISO 9001?
Yes, I have worked with ISO 9001 for years.
Did the team meet the deadline last week?
Yes, they met the deadline on Friday.
What have you done recently to improve quality?
We have recently updated the inspection checklist.
sentences: I have inspected many systems this year.
I inspected the scrubber yesterday.
We have already closed the non-conformity.
We closed the last audit last week.
The manager has approved several reports.
The manager approved this report on Monday.
The schedule has changed recently.
The team met the deadline last Friday.
grammarPoint: Present Perfect x Past Simple. Present Perfect (have/has + particípio) para experiência sem data: I have audited suppliers. Past Simple para fato com tempo definido: I audited a supplier yesterday. Palavras como yesterday, last week e on Monday pedem Past Simple.
deepDive: Se você diz QUANDO aconteceu (yesterday, last week, in 2023), use Past Simple. Se fala da experiência ou de algo que continua importante agora, use Present Perfect com already, ever, never, recently. Nunca use Present Perfect junto com 'yesterday'.
examples: I have audited many suppliers.
Eu já auditei muitos fornecedores.
I audited a supplier yesterday.
Eu auditei um fornecedor ontem.
We have already closed the case.
Nós já fechamos o caso.
We closed the case last week.
Nós fechamos o caso semana passada.
She has approved the report.
Ela já aprovou o relatório.
She approved the report on Monday.
Ela aprovou o relatório na segunda.
Have you ever failed an audit?
Você já reprovou em uma auditoria?
Did you inspect the plant yesterday?
Você inspecionou a planta ontem?
The team has improved the process.
A equipe já melhorou o processo.
The team improved the process in June.
A equipe melhorou o processo em junho.
mistakes: Com yesterday use Past Simple, não Present Perfect.
I audited many suppliers in my career.
I have audited many suppliers in my career.
Experiência sem data pede Present Perfect.
We have finished the audit last week.
We finished the audit last week.
Com last week use Past Simple.
Did you have seen the report?
No Present Perfect não usamos did.
She has approved it on Monday.
Com on Monday use Past Simple.
quick: We ___ already sent the report. (sent/have sent)
He ___ the supplier last month. (audited/has audited)
They ___ never missed a deadline. (missed/have missed)
She ___ the report on Friday. (approved/has approved)

celebrate.en: Excellent. Choosing the right tense makes your reports precise — and precision is the heart of quality management.
celebrate.pt: Excelente. Escolher o tempo verbal certo deixa seus relatórios precisos — e precisão é o coração da gestão da qualidade.

title: How our processes work
grammar: Passiva — present simple passive (is/are + past participle)
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a voz passiva no presente (is/are + particípio) para descrever processos. Em Qualidade e PCP da Delta Ducon, é assim que se explica como as peças são inspecionadas, como os gases são tratados e como os produtos são testados — sem precisar dizer quem faz a ação.
intro: When we describe a process, we often focus on the action, not the person. 'Every panel is inspected' matters more than who inspects it.
Today we practise the present simple passive. It is the natural way to explain how quality control and production planning work at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: At Delta Ducon, every part is inspected and every system is tested. In this lesson you will learn how to describe our processes with the passive voice.
vocab: Each panel is inspected before assembly.
The scrubbers are tested at the factory.
The documents are checked by the auditor.
Every measurement is recorded in the system.
The gas flow is controlled automatically.
The equipment is shipped to the client.
practice: The gas cleaning systems are ______ at the factory.
The quality documents are ______ by the auditor.
Every measurement is ______ in the database.
The emission level is ______ by the sensors.
The finished equipment is ______ to the client.

audio.title: How quality control works
audio.text: At Delta Ducon, quality is built into every step. Raw materials are checked when they arrive. Each part is inspected before assembly. The gas cleaning systems are tested at the factory. Emission levels are measured and the results are recorded in our database. When a problem is found, it is reported and a non-conformity is opened. Finally, the equipment is shipped only after it is fully approved.

readAloud: Every panel is inspected before assembly.
The scrubbers are tested at the factory.
The documents are checked by the auditor.
The measurements are recorded in the system.
The equipment is shipped after approval.
fill: The scrubbers ___ tested at the factory. (is/are)
The report ___ checked by the auditor. (is/are)
The results ___ recorded in the database. (is/are)
qa: How are the parts checked?
The parts are checked before assembly.
Where are the systems tested?
The systems are tested at the factory.
Who are the documents checked by?
The documents are checked by the auditor.
When is the equipment shipped?
The equipment is shipped after it is approved.
How is the gas flow controlled?
The gas flow is controlled by the sensors.
sentences: Each panel is inspected before assembly.
The scrubbers are tested at the factory.
The documents are checked by the auditor.
Every measurement is recorded in the system.
The gas flow is controlled by the sensors.
The equipment is shipped after approval.
Non-conformities are recorded in the report.
The raw materials are checked on arrival.
grammarPoint: Voz passiva no presente: is/are + particípio passado. Usamos para descrever processos, focando na ação. The part is inspected. — A peça é inspecionada. The systems are tested. — Os sistemas são testados. Use 'is' com singular e 'are' com plural.
deepDive: Na passiva, quem sofre a ação vem primeiro (the part), e quem faz pode aparecer com 'by' (by the auditor) ou nem aparecer. É muito usada em manuais e procedimentos de qualidade porque foca no processo, não na pessoa.
examples: The part is inspected.
A peça é inspecionada.
The systems are tested.
Os sistemas são testados.
The report is checked by the auditor.
O relatório é verificado pelo auditor.
The results are recorded.
Os resultados são registrados.
The gas flow is controlled.
O fluxo de gás é controlado.
The equipment is shipped.
O equipamento é expedido.
The welds are inspected before delivery.
As soldas são inspecionadas antes da entrega.
Non-conformities are recorded.
As não conformidades são registradas.
Raw materials are checked on arrival.
As matérias-primas são verificadas na chegada.
Every step is documented.
Cada etapa é documentada.
mistakes: The part is inspected before assembly.

celebrate.en: Great work. You can now describe how our processes run — the language of every quality procedure and ISO document.
celebrate.pt: Ótimo trabalho. Agora você sabe descrever como nossos processos funcionam — a linguagem de todo procedimento de qualidade e documento ISO.

title: What was done and found
grammar: Passiva — past simple passive (was/were + past participle)
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a voz passiva no passado (was/were + particípio) para relatar o que foi feito. Em Qualidade e PCP da Delta Ducon, é assim que se registra o que foi inspecionado, o que foi encontrado numa auditoria e o que foi corrigido — a base de relatórios de não conformidade e ações corretivas.
intro: After an inspection or audit, we report what happened. 'The defect was found' and 'the parts were checked' focus on the result, not on the person.
Today we practise the past simple passive. It is the tense of quality reports, audit findings and corrective actions at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Last week an audit was carried out at the plant. Several parts were checked and one non-conformity was found. In this lesson you will learn to report what was done in the past.
vocab: A defect was found during the inspection.
A non-conformity was opened after the audit.
The problem was corrected the same day.
The equipment was delivered on time.
The documents were reviewed by the auditor.
The damaged part was replaced quickly.
practice: A small defect was ______ during the inspection.
A non-conformity was ______ after the audit.
The problem was ______ on the same day.
The equipment was ______ to the client on time.
The quality documents were ______ by the auditor.
The damaged filter was ______ last week.
The root cause was ______ after the analysis.
The reports were ______ before the meeting.

audio.title: The audit report
audio.text: Last month an internal audit was carried out at the Diadema plant. All inspection records were reviewed and two non-conformities were found. One problem was caused by a worn filter, which was replaced the next day. The corrective actions were defined by the quality team and were completed on time. A final report was written and was sent to the client. The audit was closed with no open issues.

readAloud: A defect was found during the inspection.
A non-conformity was opened after the audit.
The parts were reviewed by the auditor.
The problem was corrected the same day.
The equipment was delivered on time.
fill: A defect ___ found during the inspection. (was/were)
The parts ___ reviewed by the auditor. (was/were)
The reports ___ reviewed before the meeting. (was/were)
The filter ___ replaced the next day. (was/were)
The results ___ recorded in the file. (was/were)
qa: What was found during the audit?
A small defect was found in one panel.
When was the problem corrected?
It was corrected on the same day.
Were the documents reviewed?
Yes, they were reviewed by the auditor.
Was the equipment delivered on time?
Yes, it was delivered on time.
Why was the non-conformity opened?
It was opened because a filter was worn.
sentences: A defect was found during the inspection.
A non-conformity was opened after the audit.
The problem was corrected on the same day.
The equipment was delivered on time.
The documents were reviewed by the auditor.
The damaged filter was replaced quickly.
The corrective actions were completed on time.
The audit was closed with no open issues.
grammarPoint: Voz passiva no passado: was/were + particípio passado. Usamos para relatar o que foi feito, focando no resultado. The defect was found. — O defeito foi encontrado. The parts were reviewed. — As peças foram revisadas. Use 'was' com singular e 'were' com plural.
deepDive: Essa é a estrutura dos relatórios de auditoria e ações corretivas: o que foi feito, quando e, se preciso, por quem (with 'by'). 'Was' vai com I/he/she/it e singular; 'were' vai com you/we/they e plural.
examples: The defect was found.
O defeito foi encontrado.
The parts were reviewed.
As peças foram revisadas.
The problem was corrected.
O problema foi corrigido.
The non-conformity was opened.
A não conformidade foi aberta.
The equipment was delivered on time.
O equipamento foi entregue no prazo.
The reports were sent to the client.
Os relatórios foram enviados ao cliente.
The filter was replaced the next day.
O filtro foi substituído no dia seguinte.
The actions were completed on time.
As ações foram concluídas no prazo.
The audit was closed with no issues.
A auditoria foi encerrada sem pendências.
The samples were measured in the lab.
As amostras foram medidas no laboratório.
mistakes: O particípio de send é sent.
A defect found during the audit.
A defect was found during the audit.

celebrate.en: Well done. You can now report audit findings and corrective actions clearly — exactly what a quality report needs.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Agora você sabe relatar achados de auditoria e ações corretivas com clareza — exatamente o que um relatório de qualidade precisa.

title: Planning results and deadlines
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender o First Conditional (if + presente, ... will ...) para falar de consequências reais no futuro. Em Qualidade e PCP da Delta Ducon, isso ajuda a discutir prazos, riscos e planos: se um material falhar na inspeção, o que vai acontecer com o lead time e a entrega ao cliente.
intro: In production planning, we talk about cause and effect. If the parts arrive late, the delivery will be delayed. If we find a defect, we will open a non-conformity.
Today we practise the first conditional. It helps you plan, warn about risks and keep deadlines under control at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: If a material fails the inspection, we will reject it. If we plan well, we will meet the deadline. In this lesson you will learn to talk about real future results.
vocab: If the parts arrive late, the delivery will delay.
If a material fails, we will reject it.
If we plan well, we will meet the deadline.
If a part fails the test, we will replace it.
If we follow the plan, quality will improve.
If there is a safety risk, we will stop the line.
practice: If the parts arrive late, the delivery will ______.
If a material does not pass, we will ______ it.
If we plan the production well, we will ______ the deadline.
If a weld does not pass the test, it will ______.
If we follow the procedure, quality will ______.
If there is a safety risk, we will ______ the line.
If the supplier is late, the lead time will ______.
If we find a defect, we will ______ the batch.

audio.title: Planning the delivery
audio.text: Good planning keeps our promises. If the raw materials arrive on time, we will start production on Monday. If every part passes inspection, we will meet the delivery deadline. But if a defect is found, we will open a non-conformity and the lead time will grow. If we control the process well, we will avoid delays. If the client changes the order, we will update the schedule at once. Careful planning today will protect our deadlines tomorrow.

readAloud: If the parts arrive late, the delivery will be delayed.
If a material fails, we will reject it.
If we plan well, we will meet the deadline.
If there is a risk, we will stop the line.
If we follow the procedure, quality will improve.
fill: If the parts arrive late, the delivery ___ delay. (will/is)
If a material fails, we ___ reject it. (will/are)
If we plan well, we ___ meet the deadline. (will/are)
If there is a risk, we ___ stop the line. (will/is)
If we find a defect, we ___ open a non-conformity. (will/are)
If the supplier is late, the lead time ___ grow. (will/is)
If we follow the plan, quality ___ improve. (will/is)
If the client changes the order, we ___ update the schedule. (will/are)
qa: What will happen if the parts arrive late?
If the parts arrive late, the delivery will be delayed.
What will you do if a material fails the test?
If it fails, we will reject the batch.
What will happen if we plan well?
If we plan well, we will meet the deadline.
What will you do if you find a safety risk?
If we find a risk, we will stop the line.
What will happen if we follow the procedure?
If we follow it, quality will improve.
sentences: If the parts arrive late, the delivery will be delayed.
If a material fails the inspection, we will reject it.
If we plan the production well, we will meet the deadline.
If there is a safety risk, we will stop the line.
If we find a defect, we will open a non-conformity.
If the supplier is late, the lead time will grow.
If we follow the procedure, quality will improve.
If the client changes the order, we will update the schedule.
grammarPoint: First Conditional: if + presente simples, ... will + verbo. Fala de resultados reais e prováveis no futuro. If the part fails, we will reject it. — Se a peça falhar, nós vamos rejeitá-la. If we plan well, we will meet the deadline. — Se planejarmos bem, cumpriremos o prazo.
deepDive: A parte com 'if' usa o presente (mesmo falando do futuro): if the material fails. A outra parte usa will + verbo. Você pode inverter a ordem: 'We will reject it if it fails.' Quando o 'if' vem primeiro, use vírgula entre as duas partes.
examples: If the part fails, we will reject it.
Se a peça falhar, nós vamos rejeitá-la.
If the parts arrive late, the delivery will be delayed.
Se as peças chegarem atrasadas, a entrega vai atrasar.
If we plan well, we will meet the deadline.
Se planejarmos bem, cumpriremos o prazo.
If there is a risk, we will stop the line.
Se houver um risco, vamos parar a linha.
If we find a defect, we will open a non-conformity.
Se encontrarmos um defeito, vamos abrir uma não conformidade.
If the supplier is late, the lead time will grow.
Se o fornecedor atrasar, o lead time vai aumentar.
If we follow the procedure, quality will improve.
Se seguirmos o procedimento, a qualidade vai melhorar.
If the client changes the order, we will update the schedule.
Se o cliente mudar o pedido, vamos atualizar o cronograma.
We will reject the batch if it fails.
Nós vamos rejeitar o lote se ele reprovar.
If the test passes, we will ship the equipment.
Se o teste passar, vamos expedir o equipamento.
mistakes: If the part will fail, we will reject it.
If the part fails, we will reject it.
Depois de if usamos o presente, não will.
If we plan well, we meet the deadline.
If we plan well, we will meet the deadline.
If the parts arrive late the delivery will delay.
If the parts arrive late, the delivery will be delayed.
Falta a vírgula depois da parte com if.
If it fails, we will to reject it.
If it fails, we will reject it.
Depois de will usamos o verbo sem 'to'.
If there is a risk, we stop the line.
If there is a risk, we will stop the line.
quick: If the part fails, we ___ reject it. (will)
If we plan well, we will ___ the deadline. (meet)
If there is a risk, we will ___ the line. (stop)
If the supplier is late, the lead time will ___. (grow)
If we follow the plan, quality will ___. (improve)

celebrate.en: Congratulations. You can now talk about plans, risks and deadlines with confidence — the core of production planning and control.
celebrate.pt: Parabéns. Agora você sabe falar de planos, riscos e prazos com confiança — o coração do planejamento e controle da produção.
